skill.basic_attack.name: Melee Attack
skill.basic_attack.description: Press J to strike in the direction you face for 0.5 hearts of damage. Each swing damages the same target only once. You retain some movement control during the attack.
skill.fireball.name: Fireball
skill.fireball.description: Press K to launch a fireball in the direction you face for 1 heart of damage. Level 1 has a 0.5-second windup; level 2 has a 0.2-second windup with the same damage. Fireballs vanish on hitting a target or wall. Movement is limited while casting.
manual.title: Controls & Help
manual.movement:
Movement & Jumping
Press A / D or ← / → to move. Press Space, W, or ↑ to jump. Tap for a low jump or hold for a higher jump; releasing early shortens the ascent. You cannot jump again while airborne. Holding through landing does not start another jump.
manual.combat:
Combat & Heart Containers
Each container holds 1 heart. Taking 0.5 hearts of damage removes half a heart; stronger attacks can deal 1, 2, or more hearts. The player has 3 containers. Press J for a 0.5-heart melee attack or K for a 1-heart Fireball. Attacks follow the direction you face. Windup, recovery, and movement limits depend on the action.
manual.training:
Training Tools
Press F2 to switch Fireball levels. The dummy has 10 heart containers and refills immediately at zero, preserving total damage and hit counts. The red enemy on the right has 3 containers and attacks left at fixed intervals for 0.5 hearts per hit. Approach it to watch the heart containers change. After death, press R or Reset Training to restore all units, positions, cooldowns, and effects, and clear dummy statistics. Your language is preserved.
manual.languages:
Menu & Language
Press Esc to open the pause menu. Select 简体中文, English, or 日本語 in the language list. A successfully saved choice is restored on the next launch. Close the menu to resume. This prototype training room has no story content.
skill.enemy_attack.name: Enemy Strike
skill.enemy_attack.description: The enemy attempts a left-facing strike every 1.5 seconds, with a 0.3-second windup and 0.5 hearts of damage. It does not track or move.

map.manual.navigation:
Rooms & Routes
Walk into an exit to enter its destination room. A and B connect both ways, as do B and C. The yellow return exit in the middle of C only leads to A; A has no matching exit directly back to C. The HUD shows the current room and explored room count. Exploration lasts only for the current map run and is not saved when you leave the map or restart.
map.manual.debug:
Debug & Reset
F3, F4, and F5 enter A, B, and C directly. F6 shows or hides collision shapes. F2 switches Fireball levels. Press R or Reset Map Sample to return to A and reset health, actions, cooldowns, attack effects, and exploration. Debug jumps help inspect rooms and entrances; verify the actual route by walking through exits.
map.manual.languages:
Menu & Language
Esc opens the pause menu, where you can change language, read the instructions, reset the map, or enter the training room. A successfully saved language choice is restored on the next launch. Close the menu to resume; the training menu lets you enter the map sample again. This sample has no story content.
